repair_steps: Check router and Ethernet/Wi-Fi uplink of the base station, power-cycle router then base station.
output.customer_reply: We have identified the likely cause and will guide you through the fix.

complaint: Every camera and sensor has shown offline since this morning, although they were all fine last night. The base station has a red light. I rebooted my phone and reinstalled the app because I thought that was the problem, but nothing changed. We had a thunderstorm last night and my neighbour says the broadband is down on our street too.
usability_reason: The response is clear and polite, and gives one actionable step (check router/uplink, power-cycle router then base station). However, it claims 'We have identified the likely cause' without any diagnostic questions or actions in the session record to support that claim, and it does not acknowledge the customer's already-performed troubleshooting or the reported broadband outage/thunderstorm context.
